title: Federal Rule 20 — permissive party joinder
summary: Rule 20 permits multiple plaintiffs or defendants when the claims have the required transaction-or-series connection and share a question of law or fact. It allows related individual claims to proceed in one action.

sections.Role in the course: Rule 20 permits multiple plaintiffs or defendants when the claims have the required transaction-or-series connection and share a question of law or fact. It allows related individual claims to proceed in one action.
sections.What to examine: Identify the shared events or asserted policy and the common question. Explain both requirements separately. Mosley shows that differing employment experiences need not defeat joinder when a common discriminatory policy is alleged.
